comments.body: @Haroenv Also i need to show transformed json data on client side
The rendering of widgets are now taking time, So i think this will be better if it after the content is rendered. What do you say @Haroenv
Asynchronous work needs to be done in the search client, the widgets themselves are synchronous :)
@Haroenv We onRender event can we do it using that?
InstantSearch will not wait to render for any asynchronous behaviour, the only place you can make a response stall is using the method I described.

I'll close this issue now, since I think the resolution is clear, but if you have more issues, please create what you have so far in a sandbox environment. We have a template available for that purpose [here](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js). Thanks!
I just need to lower the loading time by transforming data on after rendering the content. Still searching for solution
If loading time is essential, I'd suggest you do the transforming before indexing your data

@Haroenv - I agree with your comment, but the data based on which we are transforming some data is  logged in user. So I can't transform it before indexing. I need to transform is while rendering only
